# Theme: Mofka as a Building Block for Resilient HPC Workflows

**⚠ DRAFT** — this synthesis has not yet been human-confirmed. Present it to the human and run `wake theme confirm` on their behalf once they approve it (requires every cited work below to be individually human-verified first).

## Summary

Mofka's persistence and RDMA-optimized transport make it an attractive substrate for workflow resilience layers. Systems such as StreamGuard and RESILIO build directly on Mofka's topic-based publish/subscribe model to provide fault tolerance, recovery, and composable pipeline architectures for streaming HPC applications at supercomputer scale.
